name: Apache OFBiz Support and Maintenance
description: Integrations, upgrades, security releases, bug fixes, performance tuning, monitoring, cloud support, and data migration for Apache OFBiz systems, from the world's largest team of Apache OFBiz committers.

itemOffered.name: Apache OFBiz integration support
itemOffered.description: Carriers, marketplaces, accounting, and other systems stay connected to Apache OFBiz, and get repaired when an API changes.

itemOffered.name: Apache OFBiz upgrades
itemOffered.description: Move to a current release with your custom components mapped and tested before cutover.

itemOffered.name: Security releases and patches
itemOffered.description: Official Apache OFBiz security releases applied to your system and tested against your customizations.

itemOffered.name: Bug fixes and root cause analysis
itemOffered.description: Production issues traced to their real cause, so the same incident does not come back next month.

itemOffered.name: Performance tuning
itemOffered.description: Faster screens, reports, and batch jobs as your order volume grows.

itemOffered.name: Proactive monitoring
itemOffered.description: Problems flagged early, before they reach your warehouse floor or order desk.

itemOffered.name: Cloud and on-premise support
itemOffered.description: Apache OFBiz on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or your own servers, with the DevOps work that comes with it.

itemOffered.name: Data migration
itemOffered.description: Legacy data moved into Apache OFBiz and validated before anyone switches over.
